parties:
Nur Banu ----- Appellant
Vs. 
Noor Mohammad and others ----- Respondents
full_judgment: The appellant, Nur Banu, took pattan of the suit lands from Nurun Nahar Bibi, predecessor-in-interest of the respondents, by executing a registered kabuliyat, Ext. 1 on February 21, 1950 and since then she had been living there by constructing huts thereon. By a notice sent by registered post on 13.10.59 and also the notice through court on 11.10.59 the appellant was directed to vacate the suit land by the end of the Bangalee calendar year.
